question: At the accepted error-feedback c_proj endpoint, can a coupled identity-initialized pre-GELU/post-GELU orthogonal frame lower full student next-token CE when every learned checkpoint tensor is frozen?
scientific_scope: task-conditioned frozen-endpoint capacity diagnostic only; its extra optimization tokens are not a same-compute architecture result and cannot close the 0.5-TPP training gap

evidence_chain.accepted_parent: The causal hidden64+24 c_proj error-feedback run finished at validation CE 5.52736521, only 0.03556521 above the attention-only control.
evidence_chain.rejected_selector: A task16-plus-directed8 causal output selector finished at 5.60775137 and was rejected.
evidence_chain.endpoint_intervention: The rejected c_proj inserted into the parent context reproduced 1.015x of the native endpoint penalty, while the parent c_proj could not repair the co-adapted rejected context. The harmful c_proj direction and compensating wider-block context must therefore be addressed jointly.
evidence_chain.prior_chart_evidence: At the older plain-c_proj endpoint, post-GELU hidden/output rotations gained about 0.0097 CE across two seeds and a separate pre-GELU frame added about 0.008-0.010 CE, but the paired from-scratch structure did not transfer. Re-test capacity at the substantially better accepted error-feedback endpoint before any new causal run.

pregelu_frame.location: folded into dense c_fc output before GELU

postgelu_hidden_frame.location: folded into the input side of the materialized MuonMatchedGivensLinear c_proj weight

residual_output_frame.location: folded into the output side of c_proj before the identity residual addition

structure.initialization: exact identity for every coordinate group
structure.inference_cost_after_folding: none beyond the unchanged dense materialized c_fc and c_proj GEMMs

optimization_protocol.updated_parameters: only the three registered fixed-basis rotation-coordinate groups in every layer; all checkpoint tensors, Muon materialized weights, embeddings, norms, attention, and LM head are frozen
optimization_protocol.objective: next-token cross entropy on deterministic fresh train.bin windows

evaluation_protocol.data_split: val.bin only; no validation window participates in optimization
evaluation_protocol.selection: choose the registered update with lowest full-coupled primary CE, then report full-coupled, post-only, pre-only, and identity CE on both seeds at that same update

ablations.full_coupled: pre-GELU plus post-GELU hidden and residual-output rotations
ablations.post_only: post-GELU hidden plus residual-output rotations with pre-GELU coordinates set to zero
ablations.pre_only: pre-GELU rotation with both post-GELU coordinate groups set to zero
ablations.identity: all three coordinate groups set to zero

decision_rule.coupled_activation_frame_capacity: at the primary-selected nonzero update, full-coupled improves both seeds by at least 0.0075 CE versus identity, post-only improves both by at least 0.005 CE, and full-coupled improves both by at least 0.0025 CE versus post-only
decision_rule.post_cproj_frame_only_capacity: the coupled rule fails but post-only improves both seeds by at least 0.005 CE versus identity
decision_rule.interpretation_limit: even a pass demonstrates local task-conditioned capacity only; it does not establish same-budget causal transfer

performance_gate.measurement: the exact coupled cached path, optimizer, batch shape, accumulation, checkpoint, code commit, dataset, and GPU used by the diagnostic
performance_gate.numerator: conventional active-model 6N FLOPs times measured tokens per second
performance_gate.denominator: same-GPU empirical BF16 tensor-core GEMM peak
performance_gate.policy: direct foreground polling; no scientific updates unless exact-path MFU is at least 20 percent, all losses and gradients are finite, all frozen tensors are unchanged, and the separate safety-window CE increase is at most 0.05

implementation_gate.materialized_muon_cproj_cache: the production c_proj chart cache must accept the frozen MuonMatchedGivensLinear weight buffer without changing normal BlockFHT training semantics
required_tests: cached and uncached charted c_proj forwards are exact for a materialized MuonMatchedGivensLinear base
cache flush projects gradients only to chart coordinates when project_base_gradient is false
the frozen c_proj base remains bitwise unchanged
identity coordinates preserve the parent endpoint

required_artifacts: checkpoint, result, plan, and dataset-manifest SHA-256
fixed train and validation index digests
coordinate states at all registered evaluation updates

next_if_capacity_passes: Preregister one same-budget 238-update causal 124M run with separate low-LR frame coordinates active during training; endpoint gains cannot be counted as training-gap closure.
next_if_capacity_fails: Close this fixed-basis local frame family and investigate a nonlinear transported MLP connection or residual mixer without adding a learned dense basis.
